image_description: A close-up, side-profile photograph of a Rock Beauty angelfish (Holocanthus tricolor) swimming in an aquarium environment. The fish displays the characteristic bicolor pattern with a golden-yellow head and anterior body, and a large black patch covering the posterior body and dorsal/anal fins. The background consists of blurred green aquatic plants and blue water.

The anal fin mirrors the dorsal fin's shape and position, appearing structurally sound and symmetrical.
The caudal fin (tail) is visible and has a rounded to slightly truncate edge, consistent with the species.
